prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps and changing finish layouts consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens proved helpful by producing winning tests with consistent positive direction.
Adoption copy, home redesign, home wait-info, sign-in hints, and sign-in redesign showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, though pessimistic negative predictions were too low for winning tests.
Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once or without clear agreement across tests (such as adoption hint, adoption new_flow, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish incentive, finish new_flow, finish notification, home new_flow, and home new_screen).

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_animation_preview_new_flow: Introduce an interactive animation preview component on pick_friend where selecting a pet shows its live desktop idle animations. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to interact with and control pets on screen.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] story_spotlight_hero_redesign: Redesign the story screen into a spotlight hero layout featuring an animated companion mascot and key feature highlights. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, showing users take long to process initial app value.)
2: [home, hint] waiting_desktop_visibility_hint: Add a diagnostic visual hint on the waiting screen explaining where the pet will launch on the desktop once ready. (why: 3 support tickets reported issues with pets not appearing on the desktop or app failing to open.)
3: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_controls_cheat_sheet_hint: Add a quick-reference desktop controls hint on home_intro clarifying right-click menus, hiding, and interaction commands. (why: Support received 3 emails about post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
4: [adoption, incentive] pick_friend_sound_preview_incentive: Add sound preview sample components and a sound feature badge to pick_friend to encourage audio feature exploration during adoption. (why: Increases adoption engagement (69.6% conversion) by letting users test companion audio before confirming selection.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] story_checklist_layout_redesign: Redesign the story screen into a checklist layout breaking down companion capabilities and setup steps. (why: High mean completion time (514s) on choose_path suggests structured feature bullet points will guide users faster.)
6: [finish, notification] home_intro_system_tray_notification: Show a system tray notification banner on home_intro pointing users to the system tray icon location for app controls. (why: Support received reports of misbehaving features and confusion on hiding/opening desktop pets after onboarding finish.)
